excerpt.zh: 星际集会的第二阶段，领事环，现已建成。这个内环将能够容下我们大部分的外交人员在里面活动。
excerpt.en: The second stage of the Interstellar Assembly, the Consul Ring, is now complete. This inner circle will house most of our diplomatic staff going forward.
